# Nirmal Karaoke
> Browser-based online karaoke and real-time voice studio. Sing with synced lyrics, change your voice with 30+ live effects and Auto-Tune, use a hotkey soundboard, host live duets, stream to YouTube/Twitch/Facebook, and send your sound to Zoom, Meet, Teams or Discord via a virtual audio cable. No install.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://nirmalkaraoke.site/): overview, features, FAQ
- [Studio](https://nirmalkaraoke.site/studio): the web app
- [Voice changer for Zoom, Meet, Teams and Discord](https://nirmalkaraoke.site/voice-changer-for-zoom-discord): step-by-step guide using VB-Cable or BlackHole
- [About](https://nirmalkaraoke.site/about)
- [Privacy](https://nirmalkaraoke.site/privacy)
